name.fr-FR: Déposition pour la canonisation de saint François de Sales
name.en-US: Deposition in the Cause of the Canonisation of St. Francis de Sales
name.pt-BR: Depoimento para a canonização de são Francisco de Sales

description.fr-FR: La déposition de sainte Jeanne-Françoise de Chantal au procès apostolique d’Annecy (1627) pour la béatification et la canonisation de saint François de Sales : les six interrogats, puis cinquante-cinq articles sur l’enfance, la jeunesse, l’apostolat et les vertus du saint évêque, suivis de la lettre qu’elle écrivit au père dom Jean de Saint-François.
description.en-US: The deposition of St. Jane Frances de Chantal at the apostolic process of Annecy (1627) for the beatification and canonisation of St. Francis de Sales: the six preliminary questions and fifty-five points on the childhood, youth, apostolate and virtues of the holy bishop. The French edition adds her letter to Dom Jean de Saint-François.
description.pt-BR: O depoimento de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal no processo apostólico de Annecy (1627) para a beatificação e canonização de são Francisco de Sales: os seis interrogatórios e cinquenta e cinco artigos sobre a infância, a juventude, o apostolado e as virtudes do santo bispo, seguidos da carta ao padre dom João de São Francisco.

fr-FR.editor: Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation d’Annecy

en-US.translator: J. S., revised by a priest of the Archdiocese of Westminster (Visitation Convent, Harrow)

sources.edition: Sainte Jeanne-Françoise Frémyot de Chantal, sa vie et ses œuvres, Plon, Paris, 1876, tome III (Œuvres diverses II), pp. 93–248: Déposition. Archive.org OCR of the Sainte-Geneviève copy.
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script; running heads removed, notes turned into footnotes. The Latin formula before each answer (Ad primum respondit) is the notary’s and is kept.

sources.edition: The Mystical Explanation of the Canticle of Canticles … and the Depositions of St. Jane Frances de Chantal (Library of St. Francis de Sales, vol. VI), Visitation Convent, Harrow / Burns & Oates, 1908. Part II. Archive.org OCR (Toronto scan).
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script. The English follows the French in the same 55 points; the final letter to Dom Jean de Saint-François is not in this volume.
